meta.catalystsDescription: Earnings, ex-dividend and payment dates for your positions and watchlist, 10-Q/10-K deadlines and corporate actions, with access to the alerts manager.
meta.earningsDescription: Upcoming earnings of the companies in your portfolio and watchlist.
meta.iposDescription: US listings for the current and next month, with the dates planned by the source.
meta.subscriptionDescription: Get your companies' earnings in Apple, Google or Outlook Calendar.
meta.macroDescription: Upcoming FOMC meetings and macro data, and summaries of your companies' 8-Ks.

catalysts.headerDescription: From {desde} to {hasta}. Earnings and ex-dividends cover your positions and your watchlist listed in the US (USD); payment dates and ex-dividends outside the US come from your already imported dividend history (positions and watchlist); 10-Q/10-K deadlines only cover positions, and recorded corporate actions cover all your open positions.
catalysts.degradedUnavailable: The public NASDAQ calendar is not responding: earnings and dividends cannot be shown. This does not mean there are no events.
catalysts.degradedPartial: The public NASDAQ calendar failed for some days: the list may be incomplete.
catalysts.emptyNoFollow1: You have no open positions or watchlist, so there are no catalysts to follow.
catalysts.emptyNoFollow2: Follow a company or record a buy and you will see its earnings and dividends here.
catalysts.emptyRange: No events in this range. Live earnings and ex-dividends only cover the US (USD); payment dates and ex-dividends from other markets come from your imported dividend history, which only shows what its source has declared.

earnings.emptyNoFollow: You are not following any company yet: add positions or tickers to your watchlist.
earnings.emptyRange: There are no current earnings dates in the calendar for your companies in the next 60 days.
earnings.withoutDate: No current date in the calendar: {tickers}
earnings.staleDates: Date pending update (the data has not been refreshed for days): {tickers}
earnings.irTip: Official company link, verified on {date}. The live stream, recording and transcript appear there if the company publishes them.
earnings.irTipGeneral: It is the general section, not this event's page.

ipos.headerDescription: Current and next month ({months}). The dates of upcoming listings are those planned by the source and may change; only what the source publishes is shown.
ipos.degradedUnavailable: The NASDAQ IPO calendar is not responding right now. This does not mean there are no listings.
ipos.degradedPartial: The NASDAQ IPO calendar failed for one of the months: the list may be incomplete.
ipos.emptyUpcoming: The source does not publish upcoming listings with a date in this period.
ipos.emptyPriced: No listing priced in this period, according to the source.
ipos.footnote: Coverage: only some listings on US markets; other markets do not appear.

subscription.hintFollowed: Includes the earnings of your portfolio positions and of your watchlist.
subscription.hintWatchlist: Includes only your watchlist earnings; your portfolio is not shared.
subscription.errorCreate: Could not create the subscription. Try again in a few seconds.
subscription.errorRevoke: Could not deactivate. Try again in a few seconds.
subscription.regenerateNote: For security the link cannot be shown again: regenerating creates a new one and the previous one stops working. To change the filter, deactivate and create a new subscription.
subscription.stepApple2: Tap "Subscribe" when the Calendar app opens.
subscription.linkNote: The link is only shown when created. Anyone who has it can see your earnings calendar: if it is lost, generate a new one (the previous one stops working).

macro.sourcesDown: No data from: {names}. Dates from those sources are not shown.
macro.sourcesPartial: The official calendar of {names} does not cover the whole range.
macro.emptyMacro: No official events in the next 60 days.
macro.k8Note: At most the 300 most recent 8-Ks of your companies are reviewed.
macro.docAria: Open the event's official document (external link)
macro.excerptsAll: Literal excerpts from the 8-K, in English. No recalculated figures.
macro.excerptsSome: Literal excerpts from the 8-K when the full text is available, in English. No recalculated figures.
macro.excerptsNone: No excerpts: the full text of these 8-Ks was not available; each card links the official document on SEC.
